response.overview: In a family where writing horror stories is a tradition, a mother and grandmother entertains her daughter and granddaughter by telling them chilling tales of murder, violence, and gruesome horrors. Each story presents a different setting: a factory where a group of friends becomes trapped with a relentless killer, a bowling match that turns into a bloody hunt, and a church that hides a secret as macabre as it is deadly. What begins as a night of storytelling soon spirals into a nightmare as fiction starts to blur with reality.
response.title: No dejes de leer
